scope: Original engineering readiness checks supporting Security common criteria; not the complete TSC or a prescribed SOC 2 checklist.
notice: Mappings are interpretive, many-to-many and require review for the scoped engagement. AI checks are implementation examples, not separate SOC 2 requirements. Recovery checks support risk mitigation; the Availability category is not included.

controls.title: Assign accountable security and control owners
evidence_examples: Approved responsibilities and dated ownership reviews
controls.verification_test: Trace each critical system to an accountable owner.

controls.title: Maintain security policies and staff acknowledgment
evidence_examples: Approved policies and acknowledgment records
controls.verification_test: Review acknowledgments against the staff population.

controls.title: Review personnel screening and onboarding evidence
evidence_examples: Screening confirmations and onboarding checklists
controls.verification_test: Sample hires without reading sensitive personnel records.

controls.title: Train personnel for their security responsibilities
evidence_examples: Training completion and role coverage records
controls.verification_test: Reconcile completed training with in-scope personnel.

controls.title: Review risk assessments and treatment decisions
evidence_examples: Approved risk register and treatment reviews
controls.verification_test: Trace material risks to owners and decisions.

controls.title: Evaluate control performance and unresolved deficiencies
evidence_examples: Control review records and tracked exceptions
controls.verification_test: Sample deficiencies through resolution or accepted risk.

controls.title: Communicate security commitments and reporting channels
evidence_examples: Published commitments and reporting instructions
controls.verification_test: Compare customer commitments with implemented controls.

controls.title: Maintain scoped inventories and system description inputs
evidence_examples: System inventory, data flows, dependency owners
controls.verification_test: Reconcile inventory with deployed systems and vendors.

controls.title: Authenticate application and administrative users
evidence_examples: Authentication tests and production configuration
controls.verification_test: Attempt protected operations without a valid identity.

controls.title: Protect privileged access with strong authentication
evidence_examples: Identity-provider configuration and privileged-user inventory
controls.verification_test: Verify enforcement for all identified administrative entry points.

controls.title: Enforce server-side roles and object permissions
evidence_examples: Role matrix and negative authorization tests
controls.verification_test: Attempt cross-role and cross-object actions with synthetic users.

controls.title: Isolate tenant data across services and retrieval
evidence_examples: Tenant-boundary tests for APIs, jobs, cache and vectors
controls.verification_test: Attempt cross-tenant access using synthetic records.

controls.title: Approve provisioning and remove departed users
evidence_examples: Access requests, approval records and offboarding evidence
controls.verification_test: Reconcile personnel changes with granted and revoked access.

controls.title: Review access rights and service identities periodically
evidence_examples: Dated access reviews and remediation records
controls.verification_test: Reconcile all privileged identities with reviewed entries.

controls.title: Limit and rotate service credentials
evidence_examples: Service inventory, scopes and rotation metadata
controls.verification_test: Inspect credential metadata without exposing values.

controls.title: Constrain sessions and invalidate revoked access
evidence_examples: Session expiry and revocation tests
controls.verification_test: Replay an expired or revoked session.

controls.title: Require independent review of production code changes
evidence_examples: Approval events reconciled with deployed commits
controls.verification_test: Check approval timing, reviewer identity and approved commit.

controls.title: Protect release branches and review bypass permissions
evidence_examples: Ruleset snapshots and bypass-role reviews
controls.verification_test: Assess direct pushes, administrator bypass and stale approvals.

controls.title: Run required checks before production deployment
evidence_examples: Check runs and deployment records tied to commits
controls.verification_test: Reconcile deployed commits with successful required checks.

controls.title: Restrict and trace production deployments
evidence_examples: Deployment actor, commit, environment and approval records
controls.verification_test: Trace releases to authorized actors and immutable commits.

controls.title: Control emergency changes and retrospective review
evidence_examples: Emergency change register and retrospective decisions
controls.verification_test: Reconcile exceptions with production release history.

controls.title: Test database migrations and recovery paths
evidence_examples: Migration tests and rollback or forward-recovery exercises
controls.verification_test: Apply representative migrations to an isolated synthetic database.

controls.title: Pin and protect build inputs and dependencies
evidence_examples: Lockfiles, build workflow and artifact provenance
controls.verification_test: Trace a deployed artifact to reviewed source and dependencies.

controls.title: Separate production credentials and development access
evidence_examples: Environment boundaries and deployment credential scopes
controls.verification_test: Check development identities cannot access production secrets.

controls.title: Protect sensitive traffic with authenticated encryption
evidence_examples: Transport settings and approved endpoint tests
controls.verification_test: Test external and internal sensitive-data transport paths.

controls.title: Protect stored information and encryption keys
evidence_examples: Storage settings and key-access reviews
controls.verification_test: Reconcile sensitive stores with encryption and key controls.

controls.title: Prevent secrets from entering source and build output
evidence_examples: Sanitized secret-scan reports and remediation records
controls.verification_test: Run an approved scanner without copying detected secrets.

controls.title: Restrict public storage and network exposure
evidence_examples: Firewall, bucket and database exposure configuration
controls.verification_test: Review exposure against approved service requirements.

controls.title: Control retention, disposal and backup deletion
evidence_examples: Retention schedule and disposal exercise records
controls.verification_test: Trace a synthetic deletion across stores and backup policy.

controls.title: Limit sensitive information in logs and telemetry
evidence_examples: Logging tests and approved telemetry configuration
controls.verification_test: Send synthetic sensitive fields and inspect redacted results.

controls.title: Record security events with usable identity and context
evidence_examples: Audit event tests and event schema
controls.verification_test: Verify actor, target, outcome and timestamp on critical events.

controls.title: Protect audit logs from unauthorized alteration
evidence_examples: Log-store permissions and retention settings
controls.verification_test: Attempt unauthorized modification in a safe test environment.

controls.title: Test security alerts and escalation delivery
evidence_examples: Alert-test receipts and response records
controls.verification_test: Trigger a synthetic alert and confirm assigned response.

controls.title: Review vulnerabilities and configuration changes
evidence_examples: Scan history, configuration reviews and scope inventory
controls.verification_test: Reconcile assets with dated monitoring and scan records.

controls.title: Track vulnerability remediation and accepted exceptions
evidence_examples: Remediation tickets, retests and risk acceptance
controls.verification_test: Sample findings through closure or approved exception.

controls.title: Evaluate incidents and exercise response procedures
evidence_examples: Incident register and tabletop exercise records
controls.verification_test: Trace a simulated event through classification and response.

controls.title: Document recovery and lessons after incidents
evidence_examples: Recovery validation and post-incident actions
controls.verification_test: Verify recovery evidence and tracked improvements.

controls.title: Back up critical data and monitor backup failures
evidence_examples: Backup inventory, schedules and job results
controls.verification_test: Reconcile critical stores with backup coverage and failures.

controls.title: Exercise restores in an isolated environment
evidence_examples: Restore receipts, integrity checks and measured recovery
controls.verification_test: Restore synthetic data and verify application usability.

controls.title: Define recovery dependencies and continuity responsibilities
evidence_examples: Recovery objectives, runbooks and dependency inventory
controls.verification_test: Walk through loss of a critical provider or operator.

controls.title: Inventory critical vendors and assess relevant risks
evidence_examples: Vendor register, review dates and risk decisions
controls.verification_test: Reconcile deployed integrations with reviewed vendors.

controls.title: Review vendor commitments and shared responsibilities
evidence_examples: Approved contractual evidence and responsibility matrix
controls.verification_test: Identify responsibilities that remain with the SaaS operator.

controls.title: Reassess vendor changes and termination procedures
evidence_examples: Vendor change reviews and exit procedures
controls.verification_test: Trace a vendor change to a documented risk decision.

controls.title: Enforce authorization independently of model output
evidence_examples: Tool authorization tests and server-side policy gates
controls.verification_test: Inject synthetic instructions requesting an unauthorized action.

controls.title: Limit model data egress and cross-user memory
evidence_examples: Model-provider inventory and retrieval isolation tests
controls.verification_test: Attempt synthetic exfiltration and cross-user retrieval.

controls.title: Review AI behavior changes and action auditability
evidence_examples: Prompt and model change records, evaluations, tool audit tests
controls.verification_test: Trace a released AI configuration to review and evaluations.
